title: Would you enter the teleportation machine?
description:
Your perfect copy is created. It has your memories, your personality, and even your childhood experiences.

But there's a catch.

The original you is destroyed.

Would your copy actually be YOU? Or would it just be another person who believes they're you?

This is one of the strangest questions in philosophy.

Be honest. Would you enter the machine?
pinnedComment: Be honest. Would you enter the machine?
